Method of Attack: Supply chain attack compromising WordPress themes and plugins to insert a PHP backdoor
Backdoor installation via an 'initial.php' dropper file that writes a base64 encoded webshell payload into 'wp-includes/vars.php'
Remote control of infected sites through the webshell
Redirecting visitors to malware-dropping and scam sites
Impacted Systems: WordPress themes and plugins by AccessPress
Over 360,000 active WordPress websites using these plugins/themes
Attack Vector: Compromise of AccessPress website to inject backdoor into official themes and plugins
Installation of compromised AccessPress products by site admins
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'initial.php' file in main theme directory (though often deleted by malware)
YARA rule 'accesspress_backdoor_infection' detecting specific code injections and payloads
